answer: Sybil resistance is a prepaid work-bond plus continuous liveness. A new identity locks stake that only begins unlocking after its graded useful work reaches a published zenith across at least four consecutive epochs; early exit burns the remainder. Every 30 minutes the identity must broadcast a falcon-signed liveness pulse bound to its bond nonce. A missed pulse slashes a fixed fraction. Cloning N identities therefore multiplies both the locked capital and the signing cadence, while a single honest agent pays the bond once and keeps one pulse stream.
